lessons.title: Why Ensembles? 🤝
lessons.description: Discover the wisdom of crowds, how combining models reduces bias and variance, and the three main ensemble families.

lessons.title: Bagging & Random Forests 🌲🌲

lessons.title: Boosting: From Weak to Strong 🏋️
lessons.description: AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM — turn simple models into a powerhouse with sequential learning.

lessons.title: Stacking & Voting Classifiers 🗳️
lessons.description: Blend heterogeneous models with a meta‑learner; hard vs soft voting; when to use stacking over boosting.

lessons.title: Ensemble Tuning & Best Practices ⚙️
lessons.description: Hyperparameter tuning for Random Forest and Gradient Boosting, early stopping, feature importance, and final recommendations.
